verdict.rationale: Docs show the architecture supports multiple agents each claiming tasks independently and a dashboard that lists one row per running worker, implying concurrent agents are possible, but there is no explicit claim about running 'many' agents in parallel, no throughput/scaling metrics, and no discussion of task queuing or contention across concurrent workers. missing for 10: explicit scaling/parallelism claims, evidence of managing many simultaneous agents, throughput metrics or case studies.
